name: Blade (Stellar-Forged)

abilityDetails.Fractured Power Bar: Şampiyon, elindeki güç barına göre farklı özel saldırı türlerini belirli olasılıklarla kullanır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Torment: Gelen tüm hasar veren debuff'ların süresini uzatır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.

signatureAbility:
Enhanced Vampiric Immortality
Holding Block for 0.5 Seconds: While below 70% Health, Blade's healing factor allows him to Passively Regenerate [6,275.6] Health at a cost of [39.61 - 23.96]% of a Bar of Power per second.
While Regenerating from this ability, Passively Regenerate [40 - 70]% of the damage taken from Blocked hits.

abilitySections.title: A Hunter Forged in ISO - Always Active
content: Blade's Stellar Enhancement grants him a Fractured Power Bar.
The final hit of any Special Attack activated while Blade has 3 Bars of Power inflicts a Stun Debuff for 2.5 seconds. Cooldown: 16 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Danger Sense
content: Blade's heightened senses cause him to activate Danger Sense with his Special Attack 1, or 0.25 seconds after the start of a fight against Cosmic or #God Champions. This ability grants the following effects:
The Opponent is inflicted with an indefinite 50% Atrophy Passive. While this effect is active, Unblockable Buffs suffer an additional 25% reduced duration.
Inflicting a Degeneration effect Nullifies 1 True Buff.

abilitySections.title: Degeneration Effects
content: Blade only benefits from 50% of the Mystic Dispersion Mastery, but while nearby Degenerating Opponents he Passively gains 2% of a Bar of Power per second for each Degeneration, up to 10%.
Blade's Degeneration Passives deal [1,143.9] of Direct Damage over 18 seconds and scale with Base Attack only. Max stacks: 5.
Performing a Well-Timed Block inflicts a Degeneration Passive.
When an Opponent's Buff expires naturally or is Nullified, inflict a Degeneration Passive.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Musta Hurt
content: On activation, if the Opponent is suffering from 3+ Degeneration effects and Blade's indefinite Danger Sense isn't active, gain it for 20 seconds.
The first hit inflicts a non-stacking 100% Torment Debuff for 20 seconds.
The final two hits each inflict a Degeneration Debuff, dealing [5,719.5] Direct Damage over 12 seconds. Max stacks: 20.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Time For Payback
content: Ranged hits each inflict a Degeneration Debuff, dealing [6,291.45] Direct Damage over 6 seconds. Max stacks: 10.
While the Opponent is below Max Power, ranged hits also Power Steal 10.2% of a Bar of Power, granting 40% of the Power stolen.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Daywalker's Haymaker
content: Inflict 5 Degeneration Debuffs, each dealing [18,302.4] Direct Damage over 60 seconds. Max stacks: 10.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Enhanced Vampiric Immortality
content: Holding Block for 0.5 Seconds: While below 70% Health, Blade's healing factor allows him to Passively Regenerate [6,275.6] Health at a cost of [39.61 - 23.96]% of a Bar of Power per second.
While Regenerating from this ability, Passively Regenerate [40 - 70]% of the damage taken from Blocked hits.
